2481 Bungalo Lane
Spectacular home in the Bungalos at Sandestin! Great floorplan with plenty of space.

Welcome to your private Sandy Feet Retreat at Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort! This exquisite 4-bedroom, 4-bath bungalo offers unparalleled comfort and style in a prime location.

From the moment you pull into the paver driveway you will see the large 6-passenger golf cart ready for cruising to the beach, shopping, dining, movies, and all around the beautiful Sandestin Golf & Beach Resort.

As you step inside Sandy Feet Retreat, you're greeted by a spacious living area perfect for entertaining family and friends. The open layout seamlessly connects the living room, dining area, and fully equipped kitchen featuring a gas stove/oven and granite countertops, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The living area opens up to a screened porch with additional living space that leads to a paver patio equipped with a propane gas grill.

The first-floor primary bedroom boasts a king-size bed and a walk-in shower and double vanity, providing a serene sanctuary to unwind after a day of adventure. The first-floor guest bedroom features charming bunk beds and a convenient shower-tub combination, ideal for accommodating children or additional guests. For convenience, this home also features a full-size washer and dryer in the laundry room on the first floor.

Upstairs, you'll find two more inviting guest bedrooms, each with its own unique charm. One offers a plush queen-size bed, while the other is furnished with cozy twin beds. The queen room has its own en suite bath with walk in shower and the twin room shares a walk-in shower with the upstairs living area. The living area is a great space to cozy up and watch a movie on the large Smart TV or game night for the entire family.

If you’re looking for some adventure, brush up on your putting skills on the putting green located next to the community pool which are located across the street from the property, or take the golf cart over to Grand Boulevard to get your groceries, engage in some retail therapy, or grab a quick bite to eat. While out, don't forget to stop at The Village of Baytowne Wharf. This magical place is a must see on any Miramar Beach vacation. Less than 10 minutes from your doorstep, you’ll find live music, a pirate ship playground, adventure park with ziplining, boutiques and more.

Don't miss your chance to experience the ultimate getaway at Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort. Book your stay today at Sandy Feet Retreat and make memories that will last a lifetime.
